721731601.text: This is the last possible location.

721730101.text: Eh? Kama? What are you doing here?

721730104.text: Yeah, the sky's looking all strange and stuff...

721730105.text: "This" Tsurumi Island is about to be destroyed. And then, everything will start again.

721730106.text: Ah, that's the thing that you talked about yesterday...

721730107.text: However, it seems that things are even more serious than when I came here previously. Perhaps it's because you destroyed those perches...

721730108.text: The name of the child you're trying to help... it's "Ruu," right?

721730109.text: If we want to break the cycle and free Ruu, now is the time.

721730110.text: That's why I'm here. To help.

721730111.text: Did Miss Sumida ask you to do it?

721730112.text: No, I've come here of my own accord.

721730114.text: I don't know why either. I just feel like... I should be here. How should I describe that feeling... Ah. Right. It's like this.

721730115.text: "Perhaps I simply find it intolerably shameless for me to play the fly on the wall as you boldly step into Tsurumi Island."

721730116.text: "Perhaps I believe that even illusions have feelings, and so I would do ill in allowing them to suffer in this cycle."

721730117.text: "Or perhaps I simply think that I might help Ruu by breaking this perpetual ocean of fog, and in fulfilling the wishes of my ancestors I shall be freed from the 'history' that binds me."

721730118.text: Huh. Kama, since when were you...

721732103.text: Were you about to say that the Thunderbird is dead or something?

721732104.text: What? No! I was going to talk about a story that Lady Sumida told me.

721732105.text: Who do you take me for, seriously? How could I tell a child like Ruu such a thing?

721732108.text: Ugh, enough already! So, about getting Ruu off Tsurumi Island...

721732111.text: He says that he can't leave this place...

721732112.text: Perhaps Tsurumi Island sustains his existence in some way...

721732114.text: From what we've learned so far, the strange happenings on Tsurumi Island were caused by the Thunderbird destroying it.

721732115.text: It feels like we can follow this line of reasoning to find a solution...

721732116.text: We could use the Thunderbird's feathers...

721732118.text: #Paimon gets what you're trying to say, {NICKNAME}! If the state of Tsurumi Island now is due to ley line disorders caused by the Thunderbird's power...

721732119.text: Then this feather, which also has that same power, might be able to sustain Ruu's existence.

721732120.text: Are we on the same page?

721732110.text: Well, how are we going to get Ruu to Seirai Island, anyway?

721730201.text: ...I thought Kapatcir had forgotten about all this...

721730202.text: I thought that this happened because she didn't approve of the ceremony. Because she didn't like me...

721730203.text: You said that she was your friend.

721730204.text: Friends don't forget their friends' words that easily!

721730205.text: She's been waiting for you to sing for her all this time.

721730207.text: I did tell her that I would sing for her.

721730208.text: But I haven't seen her in an awful long time now...

721730210.text: (Should we tell him? Y'know, that the Thunderbird was killed on Seirai Island...)

721730216.text: Uh, Y—Yeah, that's right! Didn't we tell you before that we saw this huge storm-cloud and a shattered mountain on Seirai Island?

721730217.text: That's where the Thunderbird lives now! Y'know, we wanted to go up to Amakumo Peak to see the awesome face of the Great Thunderbird...

721730218.text: But the Thunderbird was super busy...

721730219.text: That's right, and she's had lots of baby thunderbirds too! They're all up in the clouds right now, though, and they don't come down much!

721730221.text: So there's this vortex-like storm cloud over Seirai Island...

721730222.text: Yeah! That's formed by Kapatcir and the little thunderbirds as they play and fly in circles!

721730224.text: Wow, that's amazing! I mean, I've never seen it with my own eyes, but it already sounds unbelievably amazing!

721730225.text: Kapatcir must have been even mightier than I imagined!

721730226.text: And we did say before that we'd go outside on adventures together, didn't we?

721730227.text: #Yes, I remember. You did say that we'd go see other places, {NICKNAME}.

721731101.text: Huh. So the storm really doesn't reach this place.

721731102.text: But Paimon doesn't see Ruu anywhere either...

721731105.text: Where are you? We're here to help—

721731110.text: No, no, not like that! We're looking for something more like, "Ruu, it's Kama, where are you"!

721731111.text: Ruu, it's Kama, where are you—

721731113.text: Still no response. Ohh, Paimon's getting worried...

721731114.text: Still, why is there no thunder or lightning here?

721732304.text: Well then, touch this Thunderbird feather first...

721732604.text: That's right! The Thunderbird... Kapatcir's up there in the sky.

721732605.text: She's a little busy and can't come down to hear you sing. But if you do, Paimon's sure she'll hear you!

721732608.text: Actually, I know all about it. Or should I say I've guessed what happened to Kapatcir... and to me.

721732611.text: No, it's alright. I'm so glad I got to know you! I mean, you even got me off Tsurumi Island to see the world outside!

721732612.text: I could never have imagined that I could do this in the past. You're both really awesome!

721732613.text: The clouds in the sky, the super special grass, and rocks up in the air. These were all Kapatcir's doing, right? She's so cool, too!

721732614.text: Even the air smells different. I mean, I'm not used to it, but it's amazing!

721732616.text: Well then, the weather's not the same anymore, but I've come to sing you a song, Kapatcir.

subQuests.subQuestName: Touch the feather that suddenly appeared

721731301.text: Huh, what's this? Looks like a feather...

721731306.text: That was close. You were just frozen to the spot back there...

721732902.text: If only I could have seen such sights together with everyone...

721732903.text: Ah, but I'm happy just to be able to do it with you two!

721732904.text: Still, the world beyond the fog is amazing! I never knew the sky was so high up or so large.

721732905.text: I wonder what the places Kama went to were like...

721732906.text: We can go see those places.

721732907.text: That's right! The outside world is a reeeally big place.

721732908.text: We've met lots of interesting and nice people along the way, too. You'll hit it off with them in no time!

721732909.text: There's loads and loads of awesome food, too! Sweet Madames, Almond Tofu, Sticky Honey Roasts...

721732910.text: Ooh! Sweet Madames sounds like they'll be great!

721732911.text: #That's right, we've had a ton of those in our journey, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?

721732912.text: Ooh, yeah! We also met a certain Tone-Deaf Bard during our journey. He loves music too.

721732913.text: Paimon's sure you two would be the best of friends. Maybe you'll even perform together in Mondstadt's city square!

721732914.text: #And... And... We can take you on adventures! {NICKNAME}'s a real ace at that! We'll go to all sorts of places, like the super high-up Wangshu Inn...

721732915.text: Yup, I know, and I'd love to follow you all outside as well.

721732918.text: It's all thanks to you that I was able to fulfill my promise with Kapatcir. And... I guess everyone doesn't look all weird anymore.

721732920.text: I thought that you'd broken the Perches, and I blamed you for that... Even though you're both good people.

721732921.text: It's alright! We've been on lots of adventures and got ourselves into a ton of misunderstandings. Don't take it to heart.

721732922.text: And even if you don't wanna travel with us, we've got friends who'll take care of you! We know a young lady your age in Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius...

721732923.text: So... Please leave Tsurumi Island with us, Ruu...

721732924.text: I... When we went to Seirai Island to sing for Kapatcir, I could feel that a piece of me was in that feather.

721732925.text: That's why I'd like you to take that feather of hers on your travels.

721732926.text: This way, I can travel with the two of you as well. We'll even bring Kapatcir with us, too!

721732927.text: We'll go see the outside world, and we'll hear what songs they have to sing.

721732930.text: Yup, you don't have to worry about me!

721732931.text: It was great going outside, but it was real tiring, too...

721732932.text: I'd like to rest for a bit. You can go on ahead first!

721732933.text: Oh, that's right! Could you please thank Big Brother Kama for me?

721731202.text: What happened? Paimon was worried sick, you know...

721731203.text: It seems that I was drawn into the Thunderbird's memories.

721731204.text: Eh? The Thunderbird... The same one that destroyed Tsurumi Island?

721731208.text: It's just like Lady Sumida said. The will of the Thunderbird will resurface.

721731209.text: In that case, the voice that we heard during the battle...

721730401.text: ...You know what? This story is even more bizarre than the plot of "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)."

721730402.text: Also, stop calling me "Lady" this and "Lady" that already. You're an important friend of mine.

721730404.text: Oh, come on... Should I call you a pedant for the ages, or...

721730406.text: #Oh my, oh my! It's the legendary {NICKNAME}...

721730409.text: Huh, funny. Shouldn't she make some retort at this juncture? This feels like we're departing from her character profile somehow...

721730411.text: Basically, that's what we call a combination of "image, traits, and history." Characters must adhere to the behavior prescribed in their profiles, or they will seem, well, out of character.

721730417.text: Ruu says he's thankful to you.

721730419.text: Wait, what happened? Why am I the only person who seems out of the loop here?

721730420.text: Ugh, never mind. Let's not stand around here. A change of scenery is in order, I think!

721732501.text: Coming with you on your adventures is so awesome!

721732701.text: Phew! I sure haven't sung in a long time. That was great!

721732702.text: I'm sure Kapatcir heard me, too...

721732705.text: I'd like to send this feather back to Kapatcir's home.

721731401.text: This feather's just like the last one.

721731403.text: Don't worry, Paimon will watch over you...

721733001.text: Well then, anything you want to eat? Don't be shy, now!

721733002.text: You too, Kama! As for me, I'll start with a Tri-Flavored Skewer...

721733003.text: Phew, Paimon's full. Feeling much better now, too!

721733007.text: It's no problem. I've been troubling you all this time, after all.

721733008.text: The commission has been successfully completed. Indeed, I'd say the results far surpass my expectations...

721733009.text: I'd only wanted to get one Maushiro at first to use as reference for my writing.

721733010.text: But thanks to your perseverance, I not only got that, but also the story of the Sea of Fog, and of the millennia-spanning wait of a young lad on Tsurumi Island.

721733011.text: Mm... If my writing was better, this story would win me the "This Novel Is Amazing!" grand prize for sure!

721733012.text: But Kama's also changed quite a bit... I'd say these are all far more important than the completion of "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)."

721733013.text: We've also met some important friends...

721733014.text: We didn't have a chance to travel with Ruu, but like he said, we'll definitely meet again.

721733017.text: Yup! Paimon's sure he will. After all, he waited for so long just to keep his other promise!

721733018.text: Well then, Miss Sumida, when will we get to read "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog"?

721733020.text: I've decided to stop writing it for now.

721733021.text: Wait, what!? But we worked so hard to...

721733022.text: Ah, no, it's not an issue with you. Please don't misunderstand!

721733023.text: I wish to go traveling next.

721733025.text: I... I learned something very important during this commission.

721733026.text: In the years prior to this, I lived only to create and write.

721733027.text: I learned fishing from Kujirai to write about a character who fishes for a living. His character profile was that of a masterful warrior who secluded himself in a fishing village and lived a peaceful life there, until...

721733029.text: Oh, right. Sorry... I almost went off-topic again. So, in order to better describe parties conducting illicit activities under a fictional national lock-down, Kama and I created a smuggling network that bypassed the Outlander Affairs Agency.

721731502.text: It doesn't look like Ruu's here either...

721731503.text: The feather's target seems to have been the mountain at the center of the island.

721731504.text: Kama, do you know anything about that mountain?

721731505.text: Mt. Kanna? It was where the Thunderbird reposed.

721731506.text: That place is in fact a hollow cavern from which the Thunderbird would take off into the skies like a violet meteor that could be seen even through the fog.

721731507.text: It was said by the people of Tsurumi Island that the Thunderbird dispersed that mysterious fog to protect the island...

721731531.text: (You relate the memories that came to you when you touched the feather.)

721731511.text: ...That this fog wasn't created by the Thunderbird?

721731512.text: Huh. Perhaps our ancestors were wrong.

721731513.text: Well, that's understandable, considering that you can barely see the sun or the moon from down here. Maybe the Thunderbird's light was the only light they'd ever see.

721731515.text: Ah, that's right. We saw someone who looked like an ancient version of you, Kama.

721731517.text: ...And that's what happened. They seemed to be pretty friendly with Ruu.

721731518.text: Hmm. That may truly have been my ancestor.

721731519.text: So, did the ancient Kama meet Sayo after leaving Tsurumi Island?

721731520.text: The records don't say anything about that.

721731522.text: Well, where shall we go next?

721731523.text: We'll keep looking for Ruu, of course! Let's see where the next spot is...

721733202.text: If only I could have seen such sights together with everyone...

721733203.text: Ah, but I'm happy just to be able to do it with you two!

721733204.text: The world beyond the fog is amazing! I never knew the sky was so high up or so large.

721733205.text: I wonder what the places Kama went to were like...

721733206.text: We can go see those places.

721733207.text: That's right! The outside world is a reeeally big place.

721733208.text: We've met lots of interesting and nice people along the way, too. You'll hit it off with them in no time!

721733209.text: There's loads and loads of awesome food, too! Sweet Madames, Almond Tofu, Sticky Honey Roasts...

721733210.text: Ooh! Sweet Madames sounds like they'll be great!

721733211.text: #That's right, we've had a ton of those in our journey, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?

721733212.text: Ooh, yeah! We also met a certain Tone-Deaf Bard during our journey. He loves music too.

721733213.text: Paimon's sure you two would be the best of friends. Maybe you'll even perform together in Mondstadt's city square!

721733214.text: #And... And... We can take you on adventures! {NICKNAME}'s a real ace at that! We'll go to all sorts of places, like the super high-up Wangshu Inn...

721733215.text: There's also the Grand Narukami Shrine, which is way up high too, and has a big tree that looks like a kitsune! And we can go to Sangonomiya Shrine on Watatsumi Island. That place looks like something out of a dream...

721733216.text: Yup, I know, and I'd love to follow you all outside as well.

721733219.text: It's all thanks to you that I was able to fulfill my promise with Kapatcir. And... I guess everyone doesn't look all weird anymore.

721733221.text: I thought that you'd broken the Perches, and I blamed you for that... Even though you're both good people.

721733222.text: It's alright! We've been on lots of adventures and got ourselves into a ton of misunderstandings. Don't take it to heart.

721733223.text: And even if you don't wanna travel with us, we've got friends who'll take care of you! We know a young lady your age in Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius...

721733224.text: So... Please leave Tsurumi Island with us, Ruu...

721733225.text: I... When we went to Seirai Island to sing for Kapatcir, I could feel that a piece of me was in that feather.

721733226.text: That's why I'd like you to take that feather of hers on your travels.

721733227.text: This way, I can travel with the two of you as well. We'll even bring Kapatcir with us, too!

721733228.text: We'll go see the outside world, and we'll hear what songs they have to sing.

721733231.text: Yup, you don't have to worry about me!

721733232.text: It was great going outside, but it was real tiring, too...

721733233.text: I'd like to rest for a bit. You can go on ahead first!

721733234.text: Oh, that's right! Could you please thank Big Brother Kama for me?

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the designated location to investigate

721731701.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, didn't I tell you not to come here anymore...?

721731702.text: It's good to see that you're alright.

721731703.text: But this place is super dangerous! There's thunder and lightning everywhere, and if you get struck by lightning, you'll get hurt! And I don't know why, but it looks like the storm's getting scarier than before...

721731704.text: It must because you hurt that perch... Why did you come back... *sobs*

721731710.text: Big Brother Kama... Is that really you?

721731711.text: Eh!? Wait, are you an... illusion too, Kama?

721731712.text: Oh. Lady Sumida told me to say this.

721731714.text: Come on, this isn't the time for tricks.

721731716.text: The Kama you knew led a full life after leaving Tsurumi Island. His greatest regret was not being able to help you.

721731717.text: #I'm a descendant of his. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and I are here to help you.

721731718.text: Descendant... Are you his son, then?

721731719.text: I'm afraid you're quite a few generations off...

721731720.text: Wait, I don't get it. Descendants... Does that mean that Big Brother Kama is no longer around?

721731721.text: It's been a long time, you know...

721731723.text: What happened to him after he left?

721731724.text: I waited for so, so long, until Tsurumi Island started looking like this, but he and Big Sister Sayo never returned. I've been so worried...

721731725.text: Well, I do know a little about what happened to the Kama you knew. If you'd like to listen, I could tell you.

721731727.text: ...So many things happened in the outside world, huh...

721731728.text: I never knew that the world beyond the fog was so big, or that it had so many people...

721731729.text: The unchanging nature of Tsurumi Island is the abnormal thing here.

721731730.text: Yup, and that's why we're here to help!

721731732.text: But you destroyed the Perches and made Kapatcir angry...

721731733.text: If the ceremony goes smoothly and she accepts me and our sacrifice, then everything will be fine again...

721731734.text: That might not be what the Thunderbird wants...

721731735.text: #But how would you know, {NICKNAME}? You haven't met Kapatcir.

721731736.text: She hasn't come back in so long. She must be angry...

721731737.text: I can't say this for sure, but...

721731738.text: Mmhmm. Let's give it a try.

721731801.text: Curious tunes, tiny human. Afraid not of thunder and storms?

721731802.text: Eh...? Is this... the first time I met Kapatcir?

721731803.text: The adults in the village all said that I can bring peace to thunder and storms.

721731804.text: Huh, this memory is clearer than before... Is that because Ruu is here?

721731805.text: I was too embarrassed to sing in the village, so I came here to practice!

721731807.text: Before you humans learned to make fire, the thundering storm had already swept across the ocean alongside me. With but a flap of my wings, purple lightning will tear through the clouds like serpents. My cry shakes the ocean depths and heart of the earth.

721731808.text: I have heard the songs of the trees, the strains of the cloud and rain, and the melodies sung by the blue flying dragon of the far north. I have heard every trembling chorus of fox and rabbit and worm as I descended upon the land.

721731809.text: But your song is special. It is different from that of the boar, the fish, and the Wen Kamuy.

721731810.text: You're speaking all funny. I don't get it...

721731811.text: But I guess you like my song, then?

721731812.text: I do not know. I only know that I have never heard it before.

721731813.text: Well, then I shall sing you another tune — when you come again with thunder and rain!

721731814.text: Your lives are fragile and puny. Perhaps you shall already have turned to dust before I remember this matter. But if you have not, then you shall sing for me again.

721731815.text: Everything you say is so complicated...

721731816.text: Oh, yes! My name's Ruu. What's yours? Everyone in the village calls you "Great Thunderbird," but you must have a name, right?

721731818.text: Well, that is... What should I call you? I mean, if I want to sing for you again, and I call out to you, what shall I call out?

721731819.text: I do not know. She gave me a name long ago, but I have forgotten it. I do not need such things, nor have any dared to summon me thusly—

721731820.text: Well, how about this then? Dad... I mean, Grandpa Mata taught me a few new words in the Ishine Script today. Let me try using them to give you a name!

721731821.text: Hmm... Oh! Oh, this should do!

721731822.text: And so I gave her the name Kanna Kapatcir...

721731823.text: Let's name you "Kanna K{RUBY#[S]Great Eagle of the Storm}apatcir," then!

721731824.text: ...Ridiculous. Still, it matters not to me.

721731825.text: Well, it's decided, then! I need to get back now, or the adults will worry. I'll definitely sing for you again!

721731826.text: Hah. Perhaps I shall forget you immediately, "Ruu."

721731827.text: Well, I won't forget! See you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Ruu and the others at the designated location

721731902.text: It flew off to Mt. Kanna...

721731906.text: Well, you did give her a name, after all.

721731907.text: She also remembered my promise to sing for her again.

721731908.text: But... But if that's the case, why did everyone become like this? Why did the village become like this?

721731909.text: Did we anger Kapatcir by not performing the ceremony correctly?

721731910.text: I don't think that this was what the Thunderbird was mad about...

721731911.text: I see. I understand now, more or less.

721731912.text: Well then, I suppose our next stop is Mt. Kanna.

721731913.text: But that's sacred ground. We can't set foot there...

721731914.text: #And {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you've already come around three times, and yet things haven't gotten better...

721731915.text: Well, you're the one who talked about "The Rule of Three."

721731916.text: "Good omens must occur three times for good fortune to truly descend."

721731917.text: And "You must forge past obstacles three times to succeed on the fourth."

721731918.text: ...You know what? Paimon still thinks this should be called the "Rule of Four" instead!

721731920.text: #True. You've already met with three difficulties, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

721731924.text: And since Kama... I mean, Kama's descendant has also returned, this must mean that good things are in store for us...

721731925.text: But if nothing good happens, I'll be very, very mad, you hear?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Ruu and the others at the designated location

721730302.text: Phew, Paimon really broke a sweat back there!

721730303.text: Uh huh, and you were doing the fighting, eh?

721730304.text: Oh, come on, Paimon's palms were getting all clammy watching you fight!

721730305.text: #Wow, I saw everything! That was so cool, {NICKNAME}! So cool!

721730308.text: You truly were impressive. That was very eye-opening.

721730309.text: Hmm, Paimon's still concerned about something...

721730310.text: Why... would there be this sort of monster here...

721730311.text: We fought one before back on Amakumo Peak.

721730312.text: Yeah, Paimon remembers that one too, but...

721730313.text: We seem to be forgetting something important...

721730316.text: What's this gotta do with feathers?

721730317.text: So earlier, we took a commission from the Adventurers' Guild and went to Seirai Island to investigate...

721730320.text: Uh, that's... not the main point!

721730321.text: So while we were investigating Amakumo Peak, we defeated a monster just like this one, after which we got this special feather.

721730322.text: #Oh, so that's where you got your Thunderbird feather, {NICKNAME}...

721730323.text: That means that the Thunder Manifestations that appeared here and on Amakumo Peak must have something to do with the Thunderbird.

721730324.text: If Sumida were here, she'd say something like...

721732001.text: ...Since you have allowed this one and only song to flow in blood into this earth...

721732002.text: Then until I, Kanna K{RUBY#[S]Great Eagle of the Storm}apatcir, hear that human... "Ruu"'s song once more, may these lands fall under an eternal catastrophe...

721732006.text: Huh, so that's what happened. And here I thought...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location

721732801.text: Huh, how strange. I've only been away for a while, but it feels like it's been ages...

721732802.text: I'm back, and so is Kapatcir.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Ruu at the designated location

721732401.text: So this is the heart of Tsurumi Island...

721732402.text: I should bring Lady Sumida next time. I'm sure this sight would inspire her.

721733101.text: Everything's better now, and it's all thanks to you two. I... I'm truly blessed to have had the chance to call you both my friends.

721733102.text: How I wish I could join you on your journey.

721733103.text: But... I'm really tired right now. I need to sleep.

721733104.text: So please go on ahead! I'll just be resting here for a while.

721733105.text: We'll meet again someday for sure!
